text:
Kara H.: thinking out loud — we need a canary matrix specifically for model switchovers (hosted -> quantized variant) that preserves SLAs and 'cost-shielding' for paying customers. thoughts?
Diego M.: +1. can we make it SLO-driven rather than %-traffic only? e.g., start tiny but expand on p50/p95 stability and token cost delta thresholds.
Priya S.: agree. propose phases: smoke (0.5%), latency probe (1-5%), load scale (10-25%), ramp to target. each phase gated by metrics window.
Chen L.: what metrics exactly? latency, error rate, hallucination regressions, token cost, and customer-impact score (customers served by this shard).
Kara H.: exact thresholds draft: p95 latency within +15ms, error rate +0.1% absolute, cost per 1M tokens < 1.2x baseline, quality-rerun mismatch < 2%. also require no >1 high-severity customer complaints in 1h.
Diego M.: love the customer-impact gate. also add a rollback budget: if we exceed any gate for 2 consecutive windows -> immediate rollback; if minor breach (<10%) allow one automatic backoff step.
Priya S.: can we encode backoff steps as traffic factors: [0.5x, 0.25x, 0] relative to previous slice and an automated cool-off timer?
Chen L.: yes. and add a safety lane: premium customers always pinned to baseline model unless explicitly opted in. that's our cost-shielding. we surface opt-in via tenant flag.
Kara H.: example flag schema snippet:```yaml
feature_flag: model_switch_v2
phases:
  - name: smoke
    pct: 0.5
    duration: 10m
  - name: latency_probe
    pct: 3
    duration: 30m
gates:
  p95_latency_ms: 15
  error_delta_pct: 0.1
  cost_multiplier: 1.2
rollback_budget: 2
premium_exempt: true
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model_switch_v2 at 1789999999 (smoke 0.5%) :rocket:
Diego M.: for A/B/QA we should mirror traffic into a shadow stream for full-eval on held-out prompts (no impact). capture embeddings + outputs for offline regressions.
Priya S.: telemetry: per-tenant token cost, per-route p95, quality score via prompt-set canaries, and sampled transcripts with diff annotations. dashboards + alerting thresholds required.
Chen L.: ops runbook suggestion: - automated rollback on hard gate - soft-bail: reduce pct by half for soft gate breach - manual override channel #release-war-room with a single-button rollback in console.
Kara H.: scheduling: run the smoke during low-traffic window by region, then parallelize latency_probe in other region to validate cross-region kernel behavior.
Diego M.: note: quantized variant may show higher p95 on long-context; add seq_len bucket gating (<=512, 512-2048, >2048). don't expand phase until all buckets pass.
Priya S.: agree. add canary expiry: if canary not progressed in 24h -> auto-abort and open ticket to eng-runtime.
Chen L.: i'll draft a one-pager and a minimal console flow for the flag (pct slider, seq_len buckets, premium toggle).
Kara H.: perfect. next: Priya, can you own the dashboard panels? Diego, please write the rollout automation steps. Chen, add the flag UX. I'll coordinate launch criteria with PMs and CS. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: yep, assigned.
Diego M.: on it.
Chen L.: will do.
Kara H.: thanks all — this will cut both cost risk and customer impact.
deploy-bot: Canary status update: smoke complete, metrics green. moving to latency_probe at 1790000599.
